target_customer: Professionals and teams who live in Google Calendar and want a faster, keyboard driven desktop calendar
problem: Existing calendar apps were slow, cluttered and poorly integrated with the other tools people use to plan their day.
business_model: Freemium prosumer SaaS with paid plans for individuals and teams

founders.name: Raphael Schaad
education: Bern University of Applied Sciences, BS Computer Science
MIT, MS Media Arts and Sciences
founders.background_notes: Designer and engineer; sole founder listed on the YC page. Later led Notion Calendar and became a YC General Partner.

competitors.name: Fantastical
competitors.what: Polished native calendar app for Apple platforms with natural language entry

technical_complexity.rationale: A native, fast calendar client syncing with Google Calendar needed careful performance and sync work, but a three person team with strong design and engineering skills could ship it.

defensibility.rationale: Calendar clients sit on top of Google and Microsoft data and are easy to copy; the edge was design quality and speed, not data or lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Notion acquired Cron in June 2022 and relaunched it as Notion Calendar in January 2024.

market_need_then: Sunrise had been shut down in 2016 and its fans lacked a loved replacement, while remote work increased calendar load. Evidence is the later TechCrunch framing of Cron as following Sunrise; no spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Company site is cron.com, an exact match .com, acquisition terms not found.

identity.logo: Orange Cron mark on a black background, replaced by Notion Calendar branding in January 2024
identity.visual_style: Minimal, dark mode product screenshots, large headline
identity.voice_and_tone: Short confident lines such as 'It's about time.'

branding.brand_signature: The 'It's about time.' headline and the orange icon

rebrands.why: Folded into the Notion brand after the 2022 acquisition

branding.community_and_virality: Press and reviewers covered Cron as a design led successor to Sunrise; no merch or fan community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Well regarded among productivity and design audiences and covered by TechCrunch and reviewers, but small user base and the brand was retired within two years of the acquisition.

outcome_analysis: Cron was a tiny team that rebuilt the beloved Sunrise experience with strong design, raised a $3.5M seed in March 2020 from Initialized and notable angels, and shipped publicly in late 2021. Notion bought it in June 2022 to get a native calendar and the founder, so the exit was a product and talent acquisition by a company that wanted the wedge rather than a standalone calendar business.
notes: Seed amount and investors come from a search snippet of the TechCrunch Nov 2021 article; CB Insights lists about 3.65M total and Seedtable lists only 150k, so aggregator totals conflict. Competitor sources are dated 2021, not the batch date. Acquisition price not disclosed.
